description: Schema for a single execution/progress step instant event.

chatId.description: The chat/tab identifier that produced the entry.

entryId.description: The unique identifier of the chat entry this step belongs to.

entryIndex.description: Index of the parent entry for ordering (1-based).

stepIndex.description: Index of this step within the entry for ordering (1-based).

type.description: Step type identifier (for example stack/tool/slop states).

description.description: Step description (for example which tool or slop was used).

exception.description: Optional exception message for exception steps.
